library_construction_protocol: 10X106 HEK293 cells were used for each PROseq experiment. Cells were harvested and permeabilized. A 2-biotin label run on reaction was done to label nascently transcribed RNA. 2X nuclear run-on mix was mixed with biotin labeled CTP and UTP. Nuclear run-on reaction was carried out for 3 minutes at 37ºC. Reaction was stopped by adding Trizol LS (CAT no) followed by vigorous vortexing. RNA was isolated by standard procedure. Nascently transcribed RNA was fragmented by base hydrolysis (NaoH) resulting in 100bp long RNA suitable for sequencing. Streptavidin coated magnetic beads were used to enrich for biotin labeled RNA using affinity purification. RNA was mixed with pre-washed streptavidin beads and incubated at room temperature. Beads were washed and resuspended in Trizol and RNA was isolated. A 3' RNA adaptor (VRA3-5uM) was ligated at the 3'-end of biotin labeled nascent RNA using ligation mix (T4 RNA ligase buffer, 1mM ATP, 10% PEG, RNase Inhibitor, T4 RNA ligase I). A second biotin-RNA enrichment was done to enrich for labeled nascent RNA and remove unligated adaptors. The 5' OH generated by base hydrolysis was then converted to 5' phosphate by treatment with T4 polynucleotide kinase. A 5' RNA adaptor (VRA5) was ligated at the 5' end of RNA using the ligation mix described previously. A 3rd round of enrichment was done to enrich for labeled RNA and remove any unligated adaptors. Nascent RNA is then reverse transcribed using RP1 and RTP reverse transcription primers (2.5μM each). A test PCR amplification was then done to determine number of PCR cycles for amplification. A PCR cycle that gave sufficient amount of product, no over amplification and 50-75 % of unused primers was considered optimal and used for final amplification. Full scale PCR amplification was done using the following PCR mix (1x HF buffer, 1M Betaine, 250μM dNTP mix, 250 nM RP1 primer, 250 nM RP1-n primer, 0.04 units/μl Phusion DNA polymerase). PCR amplified DNA was then size selected (150-350 bp) by PAGE purification with some modifications from the original protocol (Mahat 2016 Nat Prot). DNA was then extracted using phenol-chloroform extraction. DNA pellet was re-dissolved in nuclease free water and DNA library size distribution was monitored by capillary electrophoresis.
